$comment: Modal / dialog — the PANEL only. The scrim and the viewport padding it sits in belong to Overlay (tokens/component/portfolio/overlay.json), which Modal is composed from; there is no second copy of them here. The panel is a Card-weight surface — same card fill, sticker border, container radius, and hard offset shadow — so a dialog reads as a card that has come forward rather than a new kind of object. There is no z-index token: showModal() promotes the dialog to the browser's top layer, which no ancestor stacking context can trap.

shadow.comment: the sticker lift, held at rest — a dialog is already raised
